response: Shivneri Construction (synthetic), CT06, billed INR 14672446 for 289 jobs across all 24 wards. Every contractor works in all 24 wards, so comparisons are fair. It met deadlines on 47.1% of jobs (city 49.6%), and 26.3% were reopened within 30 days (city 24.4%). Both are near average. Median cost was 1.05 times the rate card. Still, 8 possible double bills and 5 jobs above the 30% rate card tolerance need review, including WO25-02460 after WO25-00618, and WO25-00472. Also, 59 jobs worth INR 2923442 were on DLP roads. DLP means the original contractor's warranty still applies, so repairs should cost the city nothing. These jobs should be checked. Ask the ward office whether WO25-02460 and WO25-00618 repaired the same stretch.
